meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能分析一个指定文件夹中的知识库（包含原始资料、维基文件和配置），自动提取其中的实体、隐含关系和主题，生成一个可交互的知识图谱。
howto.when: 当你知道一个Karpathy模式的维基目录路径时，直接告诉Claude你要分析它，Claude就会开始扫描、分析和生成图谱。

say.text: 请分析我的维基知识库，路径是 /path/to/wiki
say.note: Claude将开始扫描并生成知识图谱。

say.text: 帮我理解这个Karpathy模式的知识库
say.note: Claude会尝试检测当前目录或询问路径。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze a specified folder containing a Karpathy-pattern wiki (raw sources, wiki markdown, schema), extract entities, implicit relationships, and topics, then generate an interactive knowledge graph.
howto.when_en: Give Claude the path to a Karpathy-pattern wiki directory. Claude will scan, analyze, and build the graph automatically.

say_en.note: Claude will start scanning and generating the graph.

say_en.text: Understand this Karpathy-pattern wiki for me
say_en.note: Claude will detect the directory or ask for the path.
Specify directory and trigger full analysis.
